qualifications: SLOT execution_method metadata describes the planned timed execution object; correctness/profile wrappers retain per-method diagnostic names. Their mathematical modes and all buffers are identical, and all four canonical boundaries are checked.
This controls plan-storage addresses and visit order under warmed execution; it does not isolate a specific cache or prefetch mechanism.
Pairs-shuffle retains oriented pair membership; therefore any speed difference from adjacent MODE0 cannot be caused by new sharing or different pair membership.
Input/output pointer comparisons establish address invariance, not equal cache contents; the changed access order is the intended treatment.
Distinct degree,opt,rand,pairs Plan statistics are not copied into scratch; MODE0 consumes only copied tiles/order, with masks unused. This is valid only for declared MODE0 control.
Generic cache events do not establish DRAM byte reduction, and AMX busy does not establish AVX-AMX overlap.
Only three fixed synthetic fixtures and two allocation classes; no primary17 or universal conclusion.
